units.source_text: 忽然，他觉得背后有动静，回过头去一看，不知什么时候女人已经站在门口，目不转睛地朝这边望着。

en.t: Suddenly, he sensed movement behind him, and when he turned to look, the woman was already standing in the doorway, staring fixedly in his direction.

units.source_text: 到底有些隔阂，她慌慌张张，单腿往后退了一步，像求救似的，轻轻挪开视线抛向别处。

en.t: There was still some distance between them after all; flustered, she stepped back on one leg and, as if seeking help, gently shifted her gaze away elsewhere.

units.source_text: 顺着她的视线望去，在男人背后东侧的沙壁顶上，毕恭毕敬地排列着三个脑袋，正往下朝这边张望呢。

en.t: Following her line of sight, he saw three heads lined up respectfully along the top of the eastern sand wall behind him, peering down this way.

units.source_text: 毛巾围在脸上，嘴以下全部罩住了，一点看不清，可他总觉得昨天那个老头也在里面。

en.t: Towels were wrapped around their faces, covering everything below the mouth, so he could not make them out at all, but he had a strong feeling that the old man from yesterday was among them.

units.source_text: 猛地，男人拉开了架势，回过神来，决定不去管那些人，自己管自己继续干活。

en.t: Abruptly, the man braced himself, came back to his senses, and decided to ignore those people and simply go on with his work.

units.source_text: 那些家伙的注视，驱使着男人投入了工作。

en.t: The gaze of those people drove the man into his work.
